name: Jasper County, MO
findings: Jasper County has 370 nonprofit organizations. 116 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 87 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Jasper County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
34% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Jasper County list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 74% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 99 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.text: 49 housing organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
